export_evidence: ImportKey slug 'multitec' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/multitec) returned exactly 1 row, and it is an IMPORT into Dubai, not an Indian export: "2025-12-06 NOURYON CHEMICALS INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED MULTITEC PERKADOX 14-4OB CAS NO: 25155-25-3 FREESAMPLE OF NO COMMERCIAL VALUE- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC, India DUBAI, NEW ZEALAND 29209000 7636208". The Indian party in that record is the supplier Nouryon Chemicals India Pvt Ltd; 'MULTITEC' is the foreign buyer. HS 29209000 (organic chemical) has nothing to do with the declared HS 844316. Slugs 'multi-tec' and 'multitec-india' returned 0 shipment rows (page shell only, no records table).
note: No export shipment attributable to an Indian entity named Multitec / MULTI TEC was found.
